title: Acquire and prepare independently authorized regional climate history

acceptance.text: Acquire and checksum-validate the 100 annual regional requests with honest coverage and resumable failure evidence.
acceptance.evidence: All 100 annual requests complete: 99 new and one exact preflight reuse, 86,654,505 raw bytes and 5,113,360 values. Offline revalidation passed for every response; zero fill values, one coordinate-support hash, complete 2001-2025 dates and leap days. Original sandbox DNS errors are retained.

acceptance.text: Reproduce long observations, verified wide views, monthly chart payloads and provisional replay inputs offline with meaningful tests.
acceptance.evidence: Two network-forbidden normalization runs produced 786 byte-identical files: 100 long partitions with 5,113,360 observations and no fills, 168,000 complete monthly rows, 25 exact-key wide replay partitions and 560 chart payloads. Exported 1,600 user-adopted district-year context partitions with verified artifact checksums; 20 focused tests and all 90 repository tests passed.

acceptance.text: Document district extraction diagnostics, explicit user method adoption and climate-to-agronomy questions while keeping agronomic rules inactive.
acceptance.evidence: Saim explicitly adopted representative-point context after reviewing 64-anchor diagnostics: 42 selected locations, 1.57-40.50 km distance and up to four districts sharing a location. All stable IDs map to BAMIS regions; the handoff preserves inactive Maruf rules and lists unresolved calendar, rainfall-trigger and water-access questions. The absent BAMIS route is flagged.
